items.title: Enhance Connectivity Guidance
items.rationale: To provide clearer instructions on maximizing cellular connectivity for users, based on derived notes.
items.overreach_check: Rejected: includes hard performance/range-style claims that require explicit website/internal confirmation before doctrine inclusion.
items.proposed_content:
### Maximizing Cellular Connectivity for Your HogEye Camera
- The Omni directional antenna included with all HogEye camera systems is effective for over 95% of users regarding cellular connectivity. Mounting the antenna as high as possible on a T-post enhances cell service, as height improves connectivity chances. Users within eight miles of a cell tower typically achieve good connectivity with the standard antenna. For users facing connectivity issues due to topography, a 30-foot antenna cable can help elevate the antenna and improve signal reception.

items.title: Clarify Camera Setup Instructions
items.rationale: To ensure users have clear guidance on camera installation and maintenance, based on derived notes.
items.overreach_check: No overreach; all proposed content is supported by derived notes.
items.proposed_content:
### Camera Installation and Maintenance Tips
- Always mount the HogEye camera straight up and down on the T-post to prevent water ingress. The camera head can be adjusted to angle the video downwards after removing the dome with a counterclockwise twist. If the dome is difficult to remove or reattach, take a step back and reassess the process to avoid damaging the tabs.
